Implementing it requires genuine understanding of solid-state physics, translation of several interacting components (subband energies, band gap, electrical/thermal conductivity, Seebeck coefficient) into code, and non-trivial parameter handling for three crystal orientations and optimal doping. It is not a textbook operation or a simple library call.

There is no external tooling, multi-stage pipeline, or complex environment setup; the solve script simply calls a Python program with two arguments.
